metadata.label: Continuous-Time Integrator (1/s)
metadata.description: Continuous-time integration dx/dt = u with optional saturation limits.

metadata.label: Limited Continuous Integrator
metadata.description: Continuous-time integrator with clamping anti-windup bounds.

metadata.label: Filtered Continuous Derivative
metadata.description: Numerical time derivative du/dt with optional high-frequency filter.

metadata.label: Linear Transfer Function H(s)
metadata.description: Rational Laplace transfer function (b0*s + b1) / (a0*s + a1).
metadata.provenance: Linear Systems & Control Theory (Rational Transfer Function)

metadata.label: Zero-Pole-Gain Transfer Function
metadata.description: Factorized zero-pole-gain linear transfer function.

metadata.label: Linear State-Space (A, B, C, D)
metadata.description: Continuous-time linear state-space system dx/dt = A*x + B*u, y = C*x + D*u.

metadata.label: PID Controller (with Filtered Derivative & Anti-Windup)
metadata.description: Parallel PID controller P + I/s + D*N/(1 + N/s) with output clamping.

metadata.label: Unit Delay (1/z)
metadata.description: Holds and delays input signal by one sample period.

metadata.label: One-Step Memory
metadata.description: Outputs the input value from the previous integration step.

metadata.label: Zero-Order Hold (ZOH)
metadata.description: Samples and holds continuous input over discrete sample period Ts.

metadata.label: Discrete-Time Integrator
metadata.description: Forward-Euler discrete accumulator y[k] = y[k-1] + K * Ts * u[k-1].

metadata.label: Discrete IIR Filter H(z)
metadata.description: First-order discrete IIR filter (b0 + b1*z^-1) / (1 + a1*z^-1).

metadata.label: Scalar / Elementwise Gain (K)
metadata.description: Multiplies input signal by constant gain K.

metadata.label: Additive Bias
metadata.description: Adds constant bias offset to input signal.

metadata.label: Sum / Add / Subtract
metadata.description: Adds or subtracts input signals according to sign weights.

metadata.label: Product / Divide
metadata.description: Multiplies or divides input signals.

metadata.label: Absolute Value |u|
metadata.description: Outputs absolute value |u|.

metadata.label: Square Root sqrt(u)
metadata.description: Outputs square root of non-negative input.

metadata.label: Signum sgn(u)
metadata.description: Outputs -1, 0, or +1 according to sign of input.

metadata.label: Math Function (exp/log/pow/square)
metadata.description: Evaluates elementary mathematical functions.

metadata.label: Trigonometric Function (sin/cos/tan)
metadata.description: Evaluates trigonometric functions.

metadata.label: Min / Max
metadata.description: Outputs minimum or maximum of input signals.

metadata.label: Saturation Clamp
metadata.description: Limits input signal between LowerLimit and UpperLimit.

metadata.label: Dead Zone
metadata.description: Outputs zero within [LowerValue, UpperValue] deadband.

metadata.label: Slew-Rate Limiter
metadata.description: Limits rising and falling rate of change dy/dt.

metadata.label: Hysteresis Relay
metadata.description: Switches output between OffOutputValue and OnOutputValue with hysteresis.

metadata.label: Uniform Quantizer
metadata.description: Discretizes input to multiples of QuantizationInterval.

metadata.label: Relational Operator (==, ~=, <, <=, >=, >)
metadata.description: Compares two signals and outputs 1.0 (true) or 0.0 (false).

metadata.label: Logical Operator (AND/OR/XOR/NOT)
metadata.description: Performs boolean logic on signal inputs.

metadata.label: Conditional Signal Switch
metadata.description: Passes input 1 when control input u2 >= Threshold, else passes input 3.

metadata.label: Signal Multiplexer / Bus Creator
metadata.description: Combines multiple scalar signals into a vector or bus.

metadata.label: Signal Demultiplexer / Bus Selector
metadata.description: Extracts scalar elements from a vector or bus signal.

metadata.label: 1-D / 2-D / n-D Linear Lookup Table
metadata.description: Binary-search piecewise-linear 1-D (up to 32 breakpoints) and 2-D bilinear table interpolation.

metadata.label: Constant Signal
metadata.description: Outputs a constant scalar value.

metadata.label: Step Source
metadata.description: Steps from Before to After at t >= Time.

metadata.label: Sine Wave Source
metadata.description: Outputs Amplitude * sin(Frequency * t + Phase) + Bias.

metadata.label: Ramp Source
metadata.description: Outputs linear ramp Slope * max(0, t - start) + X0.

metadata.label: Simulation Clock (t)
metadata.description: Outputs current simulation time t.

metadata.label: Square Pulse Generator
metadata.description: Generates periodic square pulses with configurable period and duty cycle.

metadata.label: Subsystem Input Port
metadata.description: External input interface port for a model or subsystem.

metadata.label: Subsystem Output Port
metadata.description: External output interface port for a model or subsystem.

metadata.label: Signal Scope / Recorder
metadata.description: Records time-series signals for visualization and export.

metadata.label: Signal Terminator
metadata.description: Terminates an unconnected output signal.

metadata.label: Hierarchical Subsystem
metadata.description: Encapsulates a nested block diagram with Inport/Outport interfaces.

metadata.label: User-Defined S-Function
metadata.description: Extension point for custom AssemblyScript WASM or FMU co-simulation blocks.

metadata.label: Stateflow Finite-State Machine Chart
metadata.description: Cleanroom deterministic finite-state machine (FSM) transition evaluator with guard conditions and temporal after() logic.

metadata.label: Second-Order Continuous Integrator (1/s^2)
metadata.description: Integrates acceleration input twice to produce position and velocity states with position/velocity saturation limits.

metadata.label: Continuous Transport Delay (e^-sT)
metadata.description: Delays continuous input signal by a fixed transport time delay using a circular ring buffer with linear interpolation.
metadata.provenance: Linear Systems Theory (Pure Time Delay e^-sT)

metadata.label: Variable Transport Delay
metadata.description: Delays continuous input signal by a time-varying delay supplied on port 2.

parameters.description: Variable delay mode flag (1 = read delay from u2)

metadata.label: First-Order Hold (FOH)
metadata.description: Reconstructs a continuous-time signal by linear extrapolation between samples.

metadata.label: Discrete State-Space (A, B, C, D)
metadata.description: Discrete-time linear state-space system x[k+1] = A*x[k] + B*u[k], y[k] = C*x[k] + D*u[k].

metadata.label: Discrete Zero-Pole-Gain H(z)
metadata.description: Discrete-time transfer function specified in factored zero-pole-gain form.

metadata.label: Discrete Backward Difference (u[k] - u[k-1])
metadata.description: Outputs the difference between the current input and previous sample input.

metadata.label: Tapped Delay Line
metadata.description: Delays an input signal by N sample periods and outputs all delayed taps.
metadata.provenance: Digital Signal Processing (FIR Tapped Delay Line)

metadata.label: Vector Dot Product
metadata.description: Computes inner (dot) product of two equal-length signal vectors.

metadata.label: Polynomial Evaluation P(u)
metadata.description: Evaluates a real polynomial on the input signal using Horner's method.

metadata.label: Rounding Function (floor/ceil/round/fix)
metadata.description: Rounds input signal to nearest integer via floor, ceil, round, or fix.

metadata.label: Reciprocal Square Root 1/sqrt(u)
metadata.description: Computes inverse square root 1/sqrt(u) for positive inputs.

metadata.label: Unary Minus (-u)
metadata.description: Negates the input signal (-u).

metadata.label: Interactive Slider Gain
metadata.description: Tunable scalar gain constrained between Low and High slider bounds.

metadata.label: Mechanical Backlash (Play)
metadata.description: Models mechanical gear play / backlash deadband hysteresis where output lags input reversals.

metadata.label: Coulomb & Viscous Friction
metadata.description: Models dry Coulomb offset plus linear viscous damping friction.

metadata.label: Zero / Threshold Crossing Detector
metadata.description: Detects when input crosses a specified HitCrossingOffset in the configured direction.

metadata.label: Wrap To Zero
metadata.description: Outputs input when u <= Threshold and wraps back to zero when u > Threshold.

metadata.label: Dynamic Saturation Clamp
metadata.description: Clamps input signal u between dynamic upper and lower limit input ports.

metadata.label: Bitwise Logical Operator (AND/OR/XOR/NAND/NOR/NOT)
metadata.description: Performs bitwise logical operation on integer signal inputs or bitmask.

metadata.label: Arithmetic Bit Shift
metadata.description: Shifts bits or binary point left or right (power-of-two scaling).

metadata.label: Bit Clear
metadata.description: Clears a specified bit position of an integer signal to zero.

metadata.label: Bit Set
metadata.description: Sets a specified bit position of an integer signal to one.

metadata.label: Compare To Zero
metadata.description: Compares input signal against zero using a configurable relational operator.
aliases: simulink/Logic and Bit Operations/Compare To Zero

metadata.label: Detect Signal Change
metadata.description: Outputs true (1) when input differs from its previous sample value.

metadata.label: Detect Signal Increase
metadata.description: Outputs true (1) when input is strictly greater than its previous value.

metadata.label: Detect Signal Decrease
metadata.description: Outputs true (1) when input is strictly less than its previous value.

metadata.label: Data Type Conversion
metadata.description: Converts signal between numeric data types (double, single, int, boolean).
metadata.provenance: Numeric Type Systems & Embedded Code Generation

metadata.label: Vector / Matrix Selector
metadata.description: Selects or reorders specified elements from an input vector or matrix.

metadata.label: Vector / Matrix Concatenate
metadata.description: Concatenates multiple input signals along a specified dimension.

metadata.label: Manual Two-Way Switch
metadata.description: Toggle switch selecting between two input signals interactively.

metadata.label: Simulation / Codegen Environment Controller
metadata.description: Routes simulation-only or real-time target signal branch based on build mode.

metadata.label: Index Vector Multiplexer
metadata.description: Selects an element from data input ports using a dynamic index signal.

metadata.label: From Workspace Signal Replay
metadata.description: Reads time-series stimulus data from workspace table or dataset.

metadata.label: Piecewise-Linear Signal Builder
metadata.description: Generates piecewise-linear test waveforms over time breakpoints.

metadata.label: Swept-Frequency Chirp Signal
metadata.description: Generates a swept-frequency sinusoidal chirp for frequency-response testing.

metadata.label: Uniform Random Number Source
metadata.description: Generates uniformly distributed pseudo-random numbers within [Minimum, Maximum].

metadata.label: Repeating Periodic Sequence
metadata.description: Outputs a repeating periodic waveform defined by time and value vectors.

metadata.label: Free-Running Digital Counter
metadata.description: Increments an integer counter each sample step and wraps at 2^NumBits - 1.

metadata.label: Simscape Electrical Resistor (V = R * I)
metadata.description: Linear electrical resistor obeying Ohm's law v = R * i.

metadata.label: Simscape Electrical Capacitor (C * dv/dt = i)
metadata.description: Linear electrical capacitor storing charge q = C * v.

metadata.label: Simscape Electrical Inductor (L * di/dt = v)
metadata.description: Linear electrical inductor storing magnetic flux phi = L * i.

metadata.label: Simscape Translational Damper (F = D * v)
metadata.description: Ideal mechanical viscous damper generating resistive force F = D * v.

metadata.label: Simscape Translational Spring (dF/dt = k * v)
metadata.description: Ideal Hookean mechanical translational spring with stiffness k.

metadata.label: Simscape Translational Mass (m * dv/dt = F)
metadata.description: Ideal translational inertial mass obeying Newton's second law F = m * dv/dt.
